summary: HUHUTECH International Group Inc., a Wuxi-based nonferrous castings issuer listed on a US exchange, furnished a Form 6-K covering the six months ended June 30, 2026. The filing aggregates routine interim disclosure, bank loan agreements with PRC and Japanese lenders (Bank of Communications, Bank of Jiangsu, Bank of Nanjing, ICBC, Bank of China, Bank of Kumamoto), related-party balances, and share-count data. No transaction, stakeholder, or board action is disclosed. No special-situation event, terms, advisor, recommendation, or structural mechanic appears; the report is an ordinary foreign-private-issuer periodic update, offering no risk-arb angle.
